limitations: Thermal precursor model only: no gas transport, gas reaction, flame, ignition probability or arc.
All temperature histories are simulated; no experimental thermal validation has been performed.
Two uniform thermal nodes; surface_temperature_k is a lumped insulation temperature, not a resolved field.
Fixed wire geometry; melt flow, swelling, exposure of the conductor and significant mass loss are absent.
Energy of removed polymer uses its instantaneous condensed-phase specific enthalpy plus pyrolysis heat.
Oxygen concentration is context only; oxygen chemistry, oxidizing metal and composition-dependent gas properties are absent.
No cabin solver coupling: ambient temperature, airflow, surroundings and supports are prescribed.
No electrical contact resistance, protection-circuit dynamics, fault frequency or mission-risk estimate.
Completion without a thermal event is not evidence that fire cannot occur.
Stagnant gas heat loss uses steady cylindrical conduction to the configured outer isothermal radius.
Air conductivity, viscosity and heat capacity are fixed room-temperature engineering approximations.
Forced convection assumes perpendicular cylinder crossflow; orientation and recirculation are not solved.
The maximum of valid conduction/convection coefficients is a dominance approximation, not a mixed-convection solution.
Natural convection is included only at 1 g; all other gravity values omit residual buoyancy.
Outside the forced-correlation Reynolds-Prandtl range, heat loss falls back to the other available terms.
Support conductance is zero: axially adiabatic supports are an explicit scenario assumption.
La couverture temporelle de la prévision apprise est bornée par la projection physique ; sa durée de validité n’est pas prédite par le ML.

findings.title: Étude complémentaire · allumage de fils NiCr/LDPE (Guo et al., 2023)
findings.statement: Les points expérimentaux publiés relient le courant maintenu au délai d’allumage d’un fil NiCr/LDPE en microgravité. Ils servent au modèle de délai affiché ; cette étude n’est pas un jeu de données NASA.
findings.relevance: Source du modèle de délai conditionnel
reasons: Points expérimentaux extraits de la figure 5 ; points de simulation exclus.
Applicabilité au composant vérifiée séparément par le modèle ; aucun transfert automatique à un autre matériau.
findings.evidence_quality: Figure expérimentale publiée ; données individuelles complètes absentes

source.name: Guo et al. · Fire Safety Journal 141, 103925

conditions.forcing: constant excess current, initially quiescent gas
conditions.experimental_environment_uncertainty: Numerical nominal atmosphere is stated in Figure 2; per-test atmosphere logs are unavailable

limitations: Only published igniting cases: no non-ignitions, failure frequencies or full censoring records
26 plotted observations are not 26 verified independent raw trials; replicate counts are unavailable
Current groups are held out together; no independent study or flight-vehicle validation
Microgravity facilities have different residual acceleration and exposure time; a causal gravity effect is not identifiable
A predicted conditional delay is not an ignition probability, mission risk or remaining useful life of actual spacecraft wiring
Graphical readings retain rounding/marker-anchor uncertainty; time series and experimental uncertainty are unavailable
Classement : moins de conditions explicitement incompatibles, mécanisme, matériau, gravité, nombre de conditions renseignées compatibles, puis nature des preuves ; aucun score de sûreté.
Conditions absentes conservées inconnues ; les publications ne qualifient pas le véhicule 3D.
Le modèle numérique de délai utilise une étude complémentaire Guo et al. ; les conclusions NASA ne sont pas ses labels d’apprentissage.
